avis.texte: I drive for a living so I'm not spending too much time in direct UV light. Works for me but not so good retaining skin moisture.

avis.titre: A must for my daily skincare routine!
avis.texte: I've been using this daily for 2 months and it's fantastic! I needed an SPF moisturizer that also allowed me to use my foundation/makeup. This doesn't interfere with that application. Doesn't cause caking or a thick build up when applying liquid and/or powder foundation afterwards. It's non greasy and lightweight. Love this product! A must in my daily skincare routine!
I break out every time I use this unfortunately. Idk why with this one only
Love this lotion and sunscreen. It is light and isn't greasy. My favorite in the summer!
Love this sunscreen, has a good smell and doesn't leave my acne prone skin oily.
Applies on light. Feels light on the skin. Lightens the appearance of sun spot from aging.
Keeps my skin clear while having spf. Got every last drop lol
It is great for sensitive skin. I've been using the product for years through all of the rebranding and formulations.

I have been obsessed with this product and its predecessors for over 25 years. It is the most amazing day time moisturizer. Moisturizes, has SPF 30, make-up just glides on over it with ease. Keeps my skin from getting greasy. I was afraid it was discontinued because I could not find it last time I came to order!!! Thank goodness it was a false alarm! Please never stop making this wonderful product!

Really liked the lightweight feel and absorption. Didn't break my skin out. However each time I wore this my forehead got burned. Definitely applied enough and wasn't out longer than recommended or sweating heavily. This has not happened wirh the other SPF products I've worn under my foundation. So I gave the rest to my darker-complected husband to use 🤣
My daughter loves this product by Proactiv. We were afraid it was discontinued from the way it was previously but she has tried it and loves it.
I absolutely love my spf. I feel awesome knowing that my face is completely protected when I'm outside in the sun.
We vacation in Florida for 1-2 months in winter, and it makes me feel so good to know that I won't break out when I wear the sunscreen!

Gosh I wanted to love this so bad! It's lightweight, non-greasy, and gives my skin a nice glow. However, every time I use it, by the next day, there's zits that pop up. This is the only new product I've introduced. I believe it's the tocopheryl. :(
sun protection, moisturizing lotion, no break-outs or irritations.

I need to wear sunscreen daily because of my acne products, but I've yet to find one that doesn't clog my pores even further. Seeing the overwhelmingly positive reviews, I bought this when it was on sale. Sadly, it doesn't live up to the hype. It was lightweight on my skin, but it smells like cheap body sunblock. And every time I used it I had a new zit forming by the end of the day, without changing anything else in my skin routine. I wanted this to work so badly, but it does the opposite of being good for acne prone skin.
I was going to give 4 stars because it has a Proactiv scent I'm not in love with, However 5 stars because it does a great job as an spf as well as clearing up your face at the same time.

avis.titre: Yes, didn't break me out.  Good job Proactiv
avis.texte: Since I am using retinol, my dermatologist insists that I wear sunscreen. I have struggled to find any spf sunscreen that my reactive sensitive oily acne-prone mature skin doesn't breakout to and react to. This is my first facial sunscreen success. This one is great! Doesn't leave me greasy or overly shiny. Doesn't irritate or break out my skin. I only wish it was higher spf, but better spf 30 than nothing.

avis.titre: PHEW! Replaced Daily Oil Free Moisturizer
avis.texte: I have used the Daily Oil Free Moisturizer for 25 years! It was getting harder and harder to find. I typed in the active ingredients and found this 'new' product. It is exactly the same and I am THRILLED I can easily get this. PHEW!!!! My face LOVES this stuff! It's been the only face treatment that hasn't caused more acne, has kept my skin consistently fresh through my 20's, 30's and 40's and now into my 50's! It's light and everything needed to set our face for the day or night. Plus the sunscreen!!

I have very oily skin and hate wearing SPF. I have trial and errored so many mositurizers and this is the best one. Doesn't feel greasy or heavy on my skin. Actually has cut down on me looking greasy throughout the day. Highly recommend!
This product gives me piece of mind knowing the sunscreen part of it will protect my skin from the sun to help me avoid skin cancer. Thank you!!!
I love this product. Now it goes on, not greasy and most of all no white residue!! No breakouts and I have Eczema so it does not irritate my skin
The texture of this sunscreen is 10/10! I love it! And if does not leave a white cast on my skin either which is a relief being a woman of color. I have already bought 2 more bottles!
This sunscreen absorbs very well without feeling greasy or filmy. No sunscreen smell either. The tube has a pump dispenser to keep things clean. Highly recommend!!
I love how this doesn't make me break out and also gives me sun protection.
I love Practiv Clear Skin SPF 30! It is light on skin and doesn't clog pores. I use everday to mositurize and protect from sun's harmful rays. I would recommend to all family and friends!
I wish they still sold tj extra strength products, they were amazing...
I've used it a couple of times already and works really good!
I love the sunscreen on the face it's very good and it doesn't clog your pores.
Our daughter has been using the products for acne about 6 months and the acne is not gone. Some days it her face clears up but then it always comes back and the Proactive takes awhile to clear up.

avis.titre: This is the sunscreen I've been looking for!
avis.texte: I use this specifically on my outdoor runs. Light weight and not greasy feeling. Most of all, it helps keep my skin clear. I wish this was available years ago.

This product was a fantastic addition to my proactiv family of products - particularly during the summer months (though protecting your skin from the sun is important all year long)! I put it on as a final step for the skin care regimen, before my makeup. It doesn't leave any residue, make your face greasy, or cause breakouts! It's absolutely perfect for daily use!
I have purchased this sunscreen many times. It is the best sunscreen to use under makeup. It isn't greasy, doesn't pill and it doesn't break me out.

This sunscreen has moisturizing qualities for my mature skin but doesn't break me out like nearly all the other sunscreens that I've tried. Does not look pasty and blends right into my skin. So grateful!
This is a great product ! Protects against the harsh sun that cause discoloration & sunburn without breaking you out. Definitely worth it!
I was really looking for the original three piece set but I'm all right with what I received would rather have had proactive original
I just love Proactiv. I've been using it for about 15 years and haven't found any better. I buy it for my daughter in law, my granddaughter.
I bought this for my granddaughter who is 15 years old she is very happy and wants to do this on her own. Thank you for making my baby happy
Trusted Proactiv brand for my adult acne and doesn't break me out.
Works great! Smells clean! And just a little goes a long way!
The three step proactive MD is amazing! My skin hasn't looked this good in years. It did make it flakey for a while but the new skin looks soft, clear, and much younger! I love it.

avis.titre: finally found my holy grail sunscreen
avis.texte: i bought this on impulse. no research or recommendations as i've done with every other sunscreen i've purchased. and oh. my. gosh. i use it after my regular moisturizer and this blends beautifully and effortlessly and gives you a perfect natural glow. i've tried over a dozen sunscreens before i came across this one and i'm so glad i don't have to look any more. my favorite thing is that it doesn't feel greasy or heavy. no matter how many sunscreens i purchased that claimed to be lightweight and non-greasy, they never lived up to their claims. this one works perfectly w my skin.
Looking great so far. Had to cut back on the one cream to every other day. We will update to five stars in a couple of months most likely!
I have dark skin and the screen does not leave a white residue behind like other sunscreens and it's not oily. Loving the results so far!
If I had to choose one product this would be it. I love this SPF. Non greasy, great coverage and great moisturizer
It's good. For whatever reason it used to work better before though.
It's a great product I've been using Proative for years. It does my face well
Great product that keeps me from breaking out when other sunscreens don't
I don't use it just for sun I use it when my face gets itchy and it works great for borh

I bought proactive for my 16yo son. He's involved in lots of sports, goes to the gym, & just gets sweaty & dirty. His face was really breaking out. After only a week of using the proactive, we definitely noticed a difference.

I use this everyday. It's great. However, it does irritate my eyes, so I keep it far away from them. I have perfectly clear skin and I found myself with a little texture and redness/acne on my left cheek. I'm not sure if it was caused by this product so I will not blame it for that.
I just started my 4th week and my face made a huge difference from when I started. The dark blemishes are finally going away. Definitely recommend!
My granddaughter said the product works. Her skin is clearing up.

avis.titre: Not clearing her skin like I expected
avis.texte: I thought after 1 month of using the products, my granddaughters skin would have gotten more clear. The product doesn't seem to work as well as it is advertised

avis.titre: I buy this over and over
avis.texte: I was looking for a mosturizer with spf that would not make me look greasy. This fits the bill perfectly even for my more "mature" skin.
Goes well under makeup, not greasy, and it hasn't broke me out once.

avis.titre: Bought it for a girl for her bday gift
avis.texte: It works really well so far. It just drys her skin out she said. I do not have any pictures to show at this time. But will in the future. She does love the product. She even uses it on her back and her face. So far it is amazing she tells me.

avis.titre: Love how it feels and no white cast!
avis.texte: I love how easily I can apply it on my skin and there is no white cast! My teenage daughter loves it to. It's a daily essential before we leave the house.
